build_pretssel_vocoder: build a PretsselVocoder model with encoder frontend, transformer encoder, decoder frontend, transformer decoder, and HiFi-GAN decoder
create_encoder_frontend: create a PretsselEncoderFrontend with prosody encoder, token embeddings, position encoder, and language embedding
create_decoder_frontend: create a PretsselDecoderFrontend with variance adaptor for duration control and positional embedding
run_vocoder_forward: run the PretsselVocoder forward pass to generate waveforms from input sequences with prosody and target language
remove_weight_norm: remove weight normalization from all Conv1d and ConvTranspose1d layers in the PretsselVocoder decoder
